> This is an independent community plugin by the **Pawin** project — it is not an official"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"s an independent community plugin by the **Pawin** project — it is not an official DeepSeek product."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## The brain idea"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Pawin Brain is not a memory plugin — it is a **brain-inspired runtime** for agents, built around one"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Brain is not a memory plugin — it is a **brain-inspired runtime** for agents, built around one loop:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Remember** — an agent that cannot recall its past cannot learn from it.
- **Self-correct** — sur"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"face contradictions, repeated failures, and missing evidence instead of glossing over them.
- **Lear"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"n** — a lesson only counts when a later, different session changes its *behavior*, not when it merel"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"y writes a note about itself."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**v0.1 ships the `remember` stage** — the hippocampus. It is deliberately the foundation: every late"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"r stage reads what this one wrote down."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## What v0.1 ships"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The first, fully-tested slice of the runtime, for DeepSeek Harness:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. **Per-turn injection** — recent diary entries enter the model's context at the start of every tur"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"n.
2. **`brain_note`** — append a fact worth remembering to today's diary.
3. **`brain_recall`** — m"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ulti-word AND search over past diary entries."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Memory is a directory of plain Markdown files. No database, no network, no external service. Delete "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"the directory and all memory is gone."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Roadmap"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The later stages of the loop — **self-correct** (conflict monitoring, repeated-failure detection) an"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"d **learn** (behavior-differential proof) — are under active development and will ship as later vers"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ions. Memory is released first because every other stage depends on it."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Run from a DeepSeek Harness checkout:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` and say:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> Note down that my favorite drink is oolong tea."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Then, in a **new session** (no need to restart the server):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> What is my favorite drink? Check memory with brain_recall."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The agent recalls it from the diary on disk."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Injection** hooks `agent/pre-step` (waterfall) and appends one source-attributed message per tur"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"n — never more than once a turn, and never when the diary is empty.
- **Tools** go through the norma"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"l `ctx.tools` registry: runtime argument validation, sandbox policy, approval, and teardown all beha"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ve as with any first-party tool.
- **Storage** is append-only with O_APPEND; concurrent appends do n"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ot clobber each other."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"dsh-brain treats the diary as untrusted input and the filesystem as hostile:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Boundary | Behavior |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Dates | Strict `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar-roundtrip validation; `2026-02-30` is rejected |
| Path trave"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"rsal | Rejected at the date-parameter level; a second join check stays as defense |
| Symbolic links"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" | Rejected at three layers: memory root, `diary/` dir, and each diary file |
| Content | NUL bytes,"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" overlong lines, and over-budget appends are rejected loudly |
| Reads | Byte-budgeted with newest-t"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"ail truncation; 64 MB hard cap per file |
| Writes | O_APPEND atomic appends; concurrent writes neve"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"r interleave |
| Config | Invalid configuration fails at plugin load — never silently |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `memoryRoot` | `~/.dsh-brain-memory` | Memory root (absolute or `~`-prefixed) |
| `injectDiaryDays"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"` | `2` | Recent diary days injected per turn (incl. today), 1–7 |
| `injectMaxBytes` | `8192` | Tot"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"al injection byte budget |
| `noteMaxBytes` | `8192` | `brain_note` per-call byte budget |
| `recall"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"MaxResults` | `20` | `brain_recall` max returned hits, 1–500 |
| `recallSnippetChars` | `240` | Per-"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"hit display characters, 1–4000 |
| `recallScanDays` | `30` | `brain_recall` scan window in calendar "},{"id":"p36s6","text":"haracters, 1–4000 |
| `recallScanDays` | `30` | `brain_recall` scan window in calendar days, 1–365 |"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Example mount entry (`examples/demo.cordis.yml`):"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"This plugin is developed as a standalone directory inside a DeepSeek Harness checkout (its `@deepsee"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"k-ai/*` dependencies resolve through the harness workspace)."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"**Current state**: 84 tests passing, 100% coverage across statements / branches / functions / lines,"},{"id":"p42s2","text":" typecheck and lint clean."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"The real-composition test boots a headless assembly through the harness's own Loader; a deterministi"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"c mock LLM really calls `brain_note` and `brain_recall`, and the test asserts that the second turn's"},{"id":"p43s3","text":" injection sees the first turn's write."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"MIT © Pawin"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek."}],"truncated":false}
